verdict.rationale: Terraform docs confirm CLI-based import of existing resources into state (terraform-docs-5, terraform-docs-19, terraform-docs-6/20) and a hands-on probe shows CLI plan/apply working, but none of the evidence documents an equivalent 'generate matching configuration' feature — import only maps resources into state, requiring manual config authorship. A community report (terraform-comm-10) explicitly contradicts the story, saying there's 'no good way to handle resources created outside TF' and that they don't exist in config even after import attempts (citing third-party tools like terraformer as unreliable workarounds). Missing for 10: first-party evidence of automatic config-code generation (e.g. -generate-config-out), and independent confirmation that generated config matches real resources reliably.
